camping.name: Le camping
camping.alt: A sunny campsite by a pine forest painted in ink and gouache: a camper waving a flaming torch at a tree with glowing owl eyes, a lantern hanging from a branch with moths dancing round it, a child toasting a golden marshmallow over a leaping flame, campfire smoke curling into a rabbit that three kids try to pat, a straw hat blown off at the picnic buffet, a dog panting in the shallow water of a paddling pool, a girl whose big loop of curly hair is fastened with a shiny gold buckle, wearing hoop earrings, popcorn exploding out of a boy's pan on a camp stove while a wild raccoon stares up at it, a boy on a little blue mat lighting a candle with a match, a bear lying on all fours warming his fur by a small cosy campfire, a hand flicking a lighter at a brick barbecue, firefighters hosing a barn ablaze with roaring flames and smoke on the far hill while cows watch, a small blank brass-framed plaque on a post by the tents and a man in a patched coat mending it in the back of a van while a child brings him bread. A dirt path climbs between the tents to the tent field, and the white gate at the bottom left leads out to the valley.

doors.label: Les tentes
doors.hint: Follow the dirt path up between the tents to the tent field

tentes.name: Les tentes
tentes.alt: The tent field, split by a wooden rail fence. Left of the fence: children in a little tree hut with a rope ladder, a family hiking with a pony, a painted wooden caravan on big wheels, a girl stacking a tower of bean cans at the canteen counter, a crow teasing a boy whose orange tent has collapsed on him, a girl guide tying a knot at the washroom mirror, a couple strolling arm in arm singing a ballad, a bicycle with a leather saddlebag, a mother duck leading her ducklings along the path, a penguin waddling across the marsh with its flippers out and a bride whose long train carries three ducklings. Right of the fence: a big bearded camper by his tent warming a can of beans on a little stove, two scouts kneeling over a creased map, one of them pleading with folded hands, a boy hammering tent pegs that ring like bells, and an old tree stump covered in tiny things that can be looked at closer. A wooden arch at the bottom right leads back to the campfire.

doors.label: Le camping
doors.hint: Walk back through the wooden arch to the campfire

zooms.label: la souche
zooms.hint: Look closer at the old tree stump

souche.name: La vieille souche
souche.alt: Close-up of the old tree stump beside the two scouts with their map: two tiny children toasting acorns over a tiny campfire among miniature tents, a little stone cottage with a white sheet flapping on the washing line, a chamois on the top ledge blowing a kiss, an open camping kit full of tiny tools on a mossy shelf with a hedgehog peeking in, two tiny campers running from a skunk and dropping their tray of marshmallows, a backpack full of pockets with a hamster in the smallest one, a hedgehog snoozing on a sleeping bag with a lavender sachet, and a crab marching with a flag along a little strip of sandy shore.
